🧖 Upgrade Scenario

Wellness Retreat Positioning

Adding a hot tub, sauna, and cold plunge — anchored by an updated fire pit area — turns this 4-bedroom, 13-guest lakefront cabin into a true four-season retreat: sandy beach and 129 feet of Upper Mission Lake shoreline in summer, spa circuit and fireside evenings all winter. That combination directly attacks the market's biggest weakness — winter and shoulder-season occupancy of just 26–38% Nov–Apr — on a property whose lakefront already carries peak season.

♨️
Hot Tub
The single highest-ROI STR amenity in cold-weather markets — industry data consistently shows 15–20% higher annual revenue. Lake-view placement multiplies the photo value. Est. investment: $8–15K.
🧖
Sauna
A barrel sauna near the shoreline makes winter a selling point instead of a liability and supports a premium ADR tier. Est. investment: $6–12K.
🧊
Cold Plunge
Completes the hot/cold contrast circuit that defines the wellness-retreat category — with the lake itself as the summer plunge. Est. investment: $5–8K.
🔥
Updated Fire Pit Area
A designed lakeside gathering space (seating, lighting, hardscape) that extends shoulder-season appeal for full 13-guest groups. Est. investment: $2–5K.
📊 In-market evidence
Amenity-led positioning already wins in this market — twice over. Comp #6 in this report, a Horseshoe Lake cabin with a hot tub and fire pit, earns $69,325/yr despite only 27% occupancy — its amenity-driven ADR does the heavy lifting. And elsewhere in the Merrifield market, a 2-bedroom sleeping just 7 with the same hot-tub-plus-fire-pit setup earns $90,052/yr at 60% occupancy. This subject has more bedrooms, four bathrooms, and true sandy lakefront; pairing that base with a full wellness package puts it in a category of one for the Brainerd Lakes Area.

Investment & payback: Total wellness package estimated at $21–40K. At the base-case uplift of ~$15,900/yr in gross revenue, the midpoint investment pays back in under 2 years — before factoring the higher ADR floor, stronger winter bookability, and review/ranking momentum that compound over time. Uplift assumptions: +10–15% ADR premium and +6–10 points of annual occupancy, weighted toward the Nov–Apr window. Notably, the third-party market model already reads this lakefront at $80,387/yr as-is — suggesting the wellness-adjusted base case is well within reach for a property of this caliber.

📋 Methodology

Analysis Assumptions & Methodology

🎯 Comp Selection Criteria
  • • Premium 3-5 bedroom properties in Merrifield
  • • Sleeps 9-12 guests (aligned with subject capacity)
  • • Active AirROI performance data (12-month trailing)
  • • Luxury tier finishes and amenities
  • • Strong review ratings (4.9+ stars)
📊 Data Sources
  • • AirROI: Property-level STR revenue, ADR, and occupancy
  • • Airbtics: Market-level overlay where coverage exists
  • • Airbnb: Live listing data and guest reviews
  • • Market Research: Merrifield tourism trends
  • • Comp Analysis: 6-category scoring engine (physical, financial, quality, amenity, reliability, must-match)
⚠️ Key Assumptions
  • • Adjustable available nights per year (100-365)
  • • Professional property management
  • • Premium photography and listing optimization
  • • Competitive dynamic pricing strategy
  • • Consistent 5-star guest experience delivery
💡 Performance Drivers
  • • Peak Season: Highest demand period for Merrifield
  • • Shoulder Season: Lower-demand months with optimization potential
  • • Amenity Premium: Standout features that drive higher ADR
  • • Location Premium: Proximity to attractions and points of interest
⚖️ Important Disclaimer
This analysis provides estimated gross revenue projections based on comparable property performance and market data. Actual results will vary based on operational execution, market conditions, seasonality, and property-specific factors. Revenue estimates are before all operating expenses including cleaning fees, platform commissions, utilities, property taxes, HOA/strata fees, maintenance, supplies, insurance, and management fees. Net operating income will be substantially lower after accounting for these costs. This report is for informational purposes only and should not be considered financial or investment advice.
